units.source_text: “唔，你知道少爷的银行印鉴吗？

en.t: Well, do you know about the young master's bank seal?

units.source_text: 趁我还活着，要办那个印鉴……（不知道是怎么回事）

en.t: While I am still alive, we must do something about that seal... (I did not understand what he meant.)

units.source_text: 啊，我彻底失败了，把世代祖传的财产都弄光了。

en.t: Ah, I have failed completely and squandered all the property handed down through the generations.

units.source_text: 可是，我这辈子还是奋斗过来的啊。

en.t: But I have still fought my way through this life.

units.source_text: 原来打算到东京去见大隈（大隈重信侯）……

en.t: I had originally meant to go to Tokyo and meet Okuma, Marquis Okuma Shigenobu...

units.source_text: 想不到坐在家中竟衰弱到这样……

en.t: I never imagined I would grow this weak just sitting here at home...

units.source_text: 啊，我在松尾那儿有十七町田地，我一心只想在活着的时候把它全传给你，可没法子啊。

en.t: Ah, I have seventeen cho of farmland with Matsuo, and I wanted only to transfer all of it to you while I was alive, but there is nothing I can do.

units.source_text: （祖父年轻的时候，从事过许多事业，诸如栽培茶叶、制造洋粉等，可是全都失败了。

en.t: When Grandfather was young, he tried many businesses, such as growing tea and making Western flour, but all of them failed.

units.source_text: 另外，他相信风水，比如盖房子，盖了又拆，拆了又盖，来回折腾，以很低的价钱把田地和山林变卖光了。

en.t: He also believed in feng shui; with houses, for example, he would build and tear down, tear down and build again, and after all that trouble he sold off the fields and forests for very low prices.

units.source_text: 后来他还将所剩无几的财产一部分交给了滩地方一个叫松尾的酿酒商。

en.t: Later, he even entrusted part of the little property that remained to a brewer named Matsuo in the Nada region.

units.source_text: 祖父经常想，至少也要将这部分钱要回来。）

en.t: Grandfather was always thinking that, at the very least, he wanted to recover that share of the money.

units.source_text: 假使能让你拥有十二三町的田地，心里就踏实了。

en.t: If I could let you own twelve or thirteen cho of farmland, my mind would be at ease.

units.source_text: 大学毕业后就不至于落魄潦倒。

en.t: Then after graduating from university, you would not have to fall into miserable poverty.

units.source_text: 让你寄养在岛木（舅舅家）或池田（姨妈家）家，未免太可怜了。

en.t: It would be far too pitiful to have you fostered by the Shimaki family, your uncle's household, or the Ikeda family, your aunt's household.

units.source_text: 要是那些田地变成你的财产，我死了你也可以同师傅（前面提及的新寺庙的圣僧）商量，由你一个人守住这个家。

en.t: If those fields became your property, then even after I die you could consult with the master, the holy monk of the new temple mentioned earlier, and preserve this house on your own.

units.source_text: 只要能像鸿池（有钱人的代用语）那样有钱，就不用去当小职员了。

en.t: As long as you were as rich as Konoike, a byword for wealthy people, you would not have to become a lowly clerk.

units.source_text: 我这个想法若行得通，打算到东京去，可是很遗憾，没有去成。

en.t: If this plan of mine could work, I meant to go to Tokyo, but regrettably I could not go.

units.source_text: 说没有去成，我又不甘心这样待在家里。

en.t: Even though I say I could not go, I cannot bear to stay at home like this.

units.source_text: 我想，能让你早日成为可靠的一家之主，就一辈子不用寄人篱下了。

en.t: I think that if I can make you the dependable head of a household soon, you will not have to live under someone else's roof for the rest of your life.

units.source_text: 我的眼睛还能看见东西的话，我到大隈那儿去，是很容易的事……

en.t: If my eyes could still see, going to Okuma would be an easy matter...

units.source_text: 啊，我无论如何也得到东京去，同慈光、瑞园（新寺庙的圣僧及其子弟）和西方寺（村里的檀家寺）商量商量，好吗？”

en.t: Ah, whatever happens, I must go to Tokyo and consult with Jiko, Zuien, the holy monk of the new temple and his disciple, and Saihoji, the village parish temple, all right?
